text:
In the Dawn of her life desire

brought to her mouth the smile

on finding herself before love.


She was a girl who lived even in dreams

her ardor, and blood beat

on meeting her love.


Without the Dawn nor in the Evening

one day she asked

whether it was possible to keep

that first love of hers.

translation.title: Adolescence
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the dawn/evening frame and the adolescent question of preserving first love.
